q: You need to send billing questions, technical questions and small talk to different prompts and models. Which pattern fits?
explain: Routing classifies the input first and hands it to a specialized handler, often saving cost on easy cases.

q: What separates orchestrator and workers from parallelization?
options: The subtasks are decided by a model at runtime rather than fixed in code
explain: In parallelization you fix the split in advance; an orchestrator decides it per input.

q: When does the evaluator and optimizer pattern work best?
options: When quality is subjective and unmeasurable
When clear criteria exist and iteration measurably improves the result
When there is no stop condition
explain: It needs an evaluator that applies criteria the generator misses, and a hard iteration cap.
